context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 verified the major UI/UX overhaul: 1) Color scheme changed from Purple (#8A2BE2) / Cyan (#00E5FF) to Neon Orange (#FF6B00) / Neon Green (#39FF14) across all pages. 2) LRCLIB API integration working for synced lyrics (tested with Bohemian Rhapsody and Shape of You). 3) Social Profile page has 4 stats cards and Recent Activity placeholder. 4) Bottom nav has 8 items. 5) LiveChat uses orange/green colors. All backend APIs working. No horizontal overflow on mobile. Minor note: Some hover shadow effects in code still reference old purple rgba values but these are not visible in normal use.
